weekly.basis: Each week we set our order before the first kickoff and graded it on its players' points, ADP on the same players. Order matched is how closely an order ranked the players to the week's finish: 1.00 is the same order, 0.00 no closer than chance, below 0.00 the order runs backwards. Places off is how many places a player finished from his rank, lower is better. Starters right counts a standard 12-team lineup, the week's top 12 QBs, 24 RBs, 36 WRs and 12 TEs, and how many of them the order also put there.
